title: Tomato Casserole with Meatless Balls and White Beans
subtitle: grilled tomatoes, celery and garlic
description: Tomatoes, celery and garlic charred under the grill, then combined with white beans and pan-fried plant-based mince balls flavoured with roasted chickpea flour. Watch the vegetables near the end of grilling.

steps.text: Heat the top grill of the oven to maximum and line a baking tray with baking paper.

Gently toss the halved tomatoes, whole celery stalks, unpeeled garlic cloves, olive oil and generous salt and pepper in a large bowl. Transfer to the tray with the tomatoes cut side down and pour over the remaining oil from the bowl.
Grill for about 6 minutes until everything is browned and the tomato skins come away easily. Remove from the oven and let cool. Leave the grill on.
Bring a small pot of water to the boil and cook the white beans for about 10 minutes until soft. Drain.
Mix the plant-based mince, roasted chickpea flour, thinly sliced spring onion, salt and pepper into a uniform dough and shape into small balls.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the balls, rolling them in the pan, until golden all over. Transfer to a plate.

Roughly chop the celery, peel the garlic and return both to the tray. Add the cooked beans and the balls in a single layer, season with coarse salt and pepper, drizzle with a little olive oil and grill for 10-15 minutes until everything is golden with slightly charred edges.
